facts.text: Hotel Xcaret Arte stands in front of the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Xcaret Arte is a hotel experience in front of the Caribbean Sea, that merges hospitality, immersive art and sustainability in Mexico.

facts.text: The hotel is conceived as an homage to Mexico's artistic wealth.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Xcaret Arte is an homage to Mexico’s vast artistic wealth.

facts.text: The suites are inspired by renowned artists from Mexico's history.
facts.excerpt: suites inspired by renowned artists from Mexico’s history

facts.text: The hotel has eco-integrated architecture.
facts.excerpt: an eco-integrated architecture so that you can feel pampered in an stress-free, astonishing atmosphere

facts.text: Hotel Xcaret Arte is an adults-only hotel for guests aged 16 and up.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Xcaret Arte is an adults-only hotel (+16), designed for guests seeking rest, wellness, art, and cultural experiences in the Riviera Maya.

facts.text: Each suite category features contemporary Mexican interior design, organic amenities and artistic expressions that pay homage to Mexican culture.
facts.excerpt: Each category features contemporary Mexican interior design, organic amenities, and artistic expressions that pay homage to Mexican culture.

facts.text: River Suites overlook the emerald river that runs alongside the hotel.
facts.excerpt: These suites overlooking the emerald river that runs alongside the hotel offer a refreshing and immersive experience.

facts.text: Ocean Front Suites have a direct view of the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Rooms with a direct view of the Caribbean Sea, where the horizon transforms with the colors of sunrise or moonlight

facts.text: Some suite categories have a Swim Up option with direct access to the pool or rivers from the suite's terrace.
facts.excerpt: Some categories have a Swim Up option, which allows direct access to the pool or rivers from the suite's terrace.

facts.text: The Garden Spa, River Spa and Junior River Spa suites allow direct access to the Muluk Spa.
facts.excerpt: The Garden Spa, River Spa, and Junior River Spa allow direct access to the Muluk Spa

facts.text: The Presidential suite has two bedrooms and multiple terraces with views of the jungle and the Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: A spacious suite with two bedrooms, multiple terraces, and carefully curated artisanal spaces.

facts.text: All suites include the All-Fun Inclusive concept with unlimited access to the Grupo Xcaret parks, dining experiences and artistic activities.
facts.excerpt: All suites at Hotel Xcaret Arte include the All-Fun InclusiveTM concept, which includes unlimited access to Grupo Xcaret parks

facts.text: The All-Fun Inclusive parks are Xcaret, Xel-Ha, Xplor, Xplor Fuego, Xenses, Xoxi and Xenotes.
facts.excerpt: Unlimited access to all our parks: Xcaret, Xel-Há, Xplor, Xplor Fuego, Xenses, Xoxi and Xenotes.

facts.text: Guests can join art workshops in textiles, pottery and Latin dance, with painting reserved for Casa de los Artistas guests.
facts.excerpt: Art workshops: Textile, Painting (exclusively for guests of Casa de los Artistas), Pottery and Latin Dance

facts.text: Each of the hotel's 6 Casas hosts different Mexican artistic expressions.
facts.excerpt: Each and every of the 6 Casas of Hotel Xcaret Arte hosts different Mexican artistic expressions

facts.text: Casa de la Paz houses a library of great books.
facts.excerpt: Casa de la Paz – A library housing the greatest books ever written.

facts.text: Muluk Spa is tucked inside Casa de la Paz.
facts.excerpt: Tucked inside Casa de la Paz, Muluk Spa

facts.text: Muluk Spa is set among natural rock formations blended with jungle paths and emerald waters.
facts.excerpt: Set among natural rock formations and seamlessly blended with jungle paths and emerald waters

facts.text: Muluk Spa has massage stalls in natural caves.
facts.excerpt: 24 massage stalls in natural caves

facts.text: Muluk Spa's hydrotherapy ritual includes a sauna, steam room, cold and hot plunges, breeze showers, a cold chamber and a pool with river views.
facts.excerpt: Hydrotherapy ritual: sauna, steam room, cold plunge, hot plunge, breeze showers, cold chamber, and a playful pool with river views

facts.text: Muluk Spa offers massages, facials and sound therapy sessions.
facts.excerpt: Muluk Spa offers a wide variety of massages and facials, plus a full hydrotherapy circuit and sound therapy sessions.

facts.text: At Le Chique, Chef Jonatan Gomez Luna serves a 27-course tasting menu of contemporary Mexican cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Chef Jonatán Gómez Luna offers a modern reinterpretation of contemporary Mexican cuisine through a surprising 27-course tasting menu.

facts.text: Le Chique is a Michelin Star restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Michelin Star Restaurant

facts.text: The Culinary Group is formed by internationally renowned celebrity chefs.
facts.excerpt: Formed by a select group of internationally renowned celebrity chefs, our Culinary Group presents a wide variety of elevated culinary experiences

facts.text: Casa de la Paz has El Deseo Speakeasy.
facts.excerpt: El Deseo Speakeasy
